name: DEPwD National Fellowship for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (NFPwD)
provider: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
unchecked_criteria: Must have a benchmark disability of at least 40% under the RPwD Act 2016, with a valid disability certificate and UDID card or enrolment number
Indian nationals only; Aadhaar-based authentication is required
Not more than two children with disabilities of the same parents may receive benefits
Cannot receive another scholarship or stipend at the same time
Must pursue a regular full-time M.Phil. or Ph.D. in Science, Humanities or Social Sciences at a recognized institution
Selection is based on UGC-NET-JRF or UGC-CSIR-NET-JRF merit
Government, university and college employees (including those on study leave) are not eligible
Can be awarded only once in a lifetime
benefit: Monthly fellowship Rs 37,000 (JRF, first two years) then Rs 42,000 (SRF, up to three more years), yearly contingency grant, Rs 2,000/month escort or reader assistance, and house rent allowance where hostel is not provided. About 200 fellowships a year (150 via UGC-NET-JRF, 50 via UGC-CSIR-NET-JRF).
documents: Valid disability certificate issued by the competent authority
UDID card or UDID enrolment number
Admission proof for M.Phil. or Ph.D.
